mapper.select: SELECT region_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT sido_name FROM region WHERE region_id = #{regionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT sido_name FROM region ORDER BY sido_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_post TP INNER JOIN region R ON TP.region_id = R.region_id WHERE R.sido_name = #{sidoName} AND TP.status != 'DELETED'

SELECT TP.trade_post_id, TP.region_id, TP.title, TP.price, TP.quantity, TP.image_key, NULL AS image_url, TP.status, TP.created_at FROM trade_post TP INNER JOIN region R ON TP.region_id = R.region_id WHERE R.sido_name = #{sidoName} AND TP.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY TP.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT region_id, sigungu_name FROM region WHERE sido_name = #{sidoName} ORDER BY sigungu_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_post ( seller_user_id, region_id, title, content, price, quantity, image_key, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sellerUserId}, #{regionId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{imageKey}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT TP.trade_post_id, TP.seller_user_id, U.name AS seller_name, TP.region_id, R.full_region_name, TP.title, TP.content, TP.price, TP.quantity, TP.image_key, NULL AS image_url, TP.status, NULL AS favorite_count, NULL AS favorite, TP.created_at FROM trade_post TP INNER JOIN users U ON TP.seller_user_id = U.user_id INNER JOIN region R ON TP.region_id = R.region_id WHERE TP.trade_post_id = #{tradePostId} AND TP.status != 'DELETED' LIMIT 1
